definitions.explanation: An autumn-blooming flower with delicate petals, typically pink, white, or crimson. Very popular in Japan as a symbol of autumn.

examples.japanese: {秋|あき}になるとコスモスが{咲|さ}く。
コスモス{畑|ばたけ}を{見|み}に{行|い}った。
examples.english: I went to see a cosmos field.

examples.japanese: ピンクと{白|しろ}のコスモスが{風|かぜ}に{揺|ゆ}れている。
examples.english: Pink and white cosmos are swaying in the wind.

notes:
JAPANESE NAME:
Also called {秋桜|こすもす} using ateji (phonetic kanji usage), where {秋|あき} (autumn) + {桜|さくら} (cherry blossom) reflects its status as an autumn flower with cherry blossom-like beauty.

ORIGIN:
Originally from Mexico, introduced to Japan in the Meiji era. The name comes from Greek "kosmos" meaning order/harmony.

SEASONAL SIGNIFICANCE:
Cosmopolitan cosmos is a {秋|あき}の{季語|きご} (autumn seasonal word) in haiku and represents:
・Autumn scenery
・Delicate beauty
・Transience

FAMOUS VIEWING SPOTS:
・{昭和記念公園|しょうわきねんこうえん} (Tokyo)
・{万博記念公園|ばんぱくきねんこうえん} (Osaka)
・Various {コスモス{祭|まつ}り|cosmos festivals} across Japan

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・コスモスが{咲|さ}く (cosmos bloom)
・コスモス{畑|ばたけ} (cosmos field)
・コスモスの{花|はな} (cosmos flower)
・{一面|いちめん}のコスモス (a field covered with cosmos)
